notes: Project LLC for Gravity, Kaufman Development's mixed-use project at 500 W. Broad St. in Franklinton; the 990 lists the LLC at 30 Warren St., Columbus, which is Kaufman Development's office, and JobsOhio's 2017 metrics show a $1.2M Revitalization Grant plus a $2.8M loan on a $20.6M investment. Kaufman is a private Columbus developer founded 2011 that LinkedIn now lists at 51-200 employees, so the 2018 bucket is a judgment call at the boundary.

Privately held Findlay third-party logistics firm (CEO Chuck Bills) that began in a single Findlay warehouse in June 1988 and now runs about 25 sites in several states; LinkedIn lists 201-500 employees and the company says 'over 400 associates.' The 2018 grant was a $110K economic development grant in Huron County and the 2024 grant a $1M OSIP spec-building grant, a site program, though the recipient is the operating company.

Operating subsidiary of Univar Solutions Inc. (NYSE: UNVR until 2023), Downers Grove, IL, whose 2019 10-K reports about 10,300 full-time-equivalent employees worldwide; Form 5500 shows 5,850 participants in 2019 and 8,613 in 2023. Apollo Funds took Univar private in August 2023, so the FY2024 grant year falls under private-equity ownership with the same operating company and HQ.

Supply-chain subsidiary of Campbell Soup Company (NYSE: CPB), Camden, NJ, whose FY2017 10-K reports approximately 18,000 employees; the JobsOhio workforce grant supported the Napoleon, OH plant, where 1,382 jobs were retained.

Independent Cincinnati craft brewer founded in 2013 that filed a 2012 Form D with the SEC listing a Cincinnati address; the 2017 Revitalization Grant and loan funded its Oakley brewery and taproom, where JobsOhio recorded 31 retained jobs. The company site and LinkedIn page could not be fetched, so the bucket rests on the retained-jobs floor plus a taproom-and-restaurant workforce that grew past 100 after the Oakley opening; confirm the 2017 headcount before use.

Private thermoset composite molder founded 1970 and headquartered in Chagrin Falls, OH, with four North American plants (Painesville, OH among them) and a China facility; Form 5500 shows 510 participants in 2015 and 521 in 2019, counts that include former employees with balances, and LinkedIn lists 201-500 employees. The company sits near the 500 line, and the Painesville site retained 116 jobs.

Privately held Cleveland maker of photo mounts and specialty packaging; its own Form 5500 plan shows 436 participants in 2015, 315 in 2019 and 155 in 2023, and JobsOhio recorded 120 retained jobs for the 2020 grant. No parent found; the LinkedIn page understates the company at 2-10 employees, so the Form 5500 count decides the bucket.

Private IT services firm founded 2010 in Simi Valley, CA, headquartered in Westlake Village, CA, with offices in India, the UK, Singapore and the Middle East; Team NEO's December 2020 release on its Solon, OH security operations center promised 109 new jobs. Form 5500 shows only 36 US participants in 2019 and 81 in 2023, while LinkedIn now lists 586 employees worldwide, so the 2022 global figure likely fell in the low hundreds.

Ohio affiliate of M&M Industries, Inc., the privately held Chattanooga, TN plastic pail and container maker whose EIN this is; the Form 5500 plan sponsored by M & M Industries Inc shows 280 participants in 2015, 400 in 2019 and 503 in 2023, which includes former employees. The company site could not be fetched and no press release with a headcount was found, so the bucket is a coin flip at the 500 line based on the 2023 plan count and the new Ohio plant.

Project LLC at 2615 Crystal Ave., Findlay, that received a $1.08M JobsOhio Revitalization Grant (October 2017) and a $1.96M Revitalization Loan on a $6.95M Hancock County project with no jobs recorded. JobsOhio newsroom, The Courier and web searches returned nothing on the LLC or its principals (search engines were blocked this session), so the developer, its size and any operating tenant remain unresolved.

Waverly, OH stamping plant of KIRCHHOFF Automotive, the largest division of the family-owned KIRCHHOFF Group of Iserlohn, Germany (automotive division based in Attendorn), which employs roughly 13,000 people worldwide with several thousand in the automotive unit alone. JobsOhio recorded 230 retained jobs at Waverly for the 2021-2022 grants.

Project LLC listed at 6001 Euclid Ave., Cleveland, that received a $1.06M Revitalization Grant (August 2017) and a $3.36M Revitalization Loan on a $22M Cuyahoga County MidTown project; the name and address point to a building at Euclid and E. 59th St. in the MidTown corridor, where Geis Companies' Hemingway Development built Link59, but no release naming the developer was found. Search engines were blocked this session and OpenCorporates and Crain's could not be fetched, so the developer and size are unresolved.

Single-purpose LLC for a spec industrial building at 2509 Hayes Ave. in Sandusky (Erie County) funded by a $1.3M JobsOhio OSIP spec development grant (May 2021) on a $21.3M investment; the 990 lists it at 2500 S. Highland Ave., Lombard, IL, a suburban Chicago office address for an industrial developer whose name could not be confirmed. Searched JobsOhio and web sources (search engines blocked this session); the parent is an out-of-state real estate developer of unknown size.

LLC formed around 2020 (EIN prefix 85) at 207 S. Central Ave., Lima, with a $1.01M FY2024 JobsOhio grant and no matching JobsOhio metrics record, which fits a revitalization or site grant to a local real estate vehicle rather than an operating company. Lima News and JobsOhio pages could not be fetched and search engines were blocked this session, so the developer and size are unresolved; the class is inferred from the name and the missing metrics row.

West Carrollton, OH manufacturing subsidiary of NuVasive, Inc. (NASDAQ: NUVA), San Diego, whose 10-Ks report about 2,600 employees at end of 2018 and about 3,000 at end of 2022; JobsOhio recorded 97 retained jobs. Globus Medical (Audubon, PA) acquired NuVasive on September 1, 2023, so the FY2024 grant year falls under Globus, which had over 5,000 employees after the merger.

Independent supply-chain IoT software firm founded 2004, based in North Canton/Green, OH; its Form 5500 plan shows 31 participants in 2015, 43 in 2019 and 94 in 2023, and JobsOhio recorded 52 retained jobs for the 2020 grant. LinkedIn now lists 51-200 employees, so the company likely crossed 100 after the grant year.

Broker-dealer subsidiary of Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS), New York, whose 2019 10-K reports 60,431 employees worldwide; the Form 5500 plan sponsored by Morgan Stanley Domestic Holdings shows 61,784 participants in 2019. The workforce grants supported an Ohio operations site where 426 jobs were retained.

Distribution subsidiary of The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE: PG), Cincinnati, whose FY2015 10-K reports 110,000 employees as of June 30, 2015. P&G was founded in Cincinnati in 1837; no JobsOhio metrics row matched this $1M FY2015 grant.

Privately held, venture-backed pharmacogenomics lab in Mason, OH (GeneSight test) that was independent during FY2016; Myriad Genetics (Salt Lake City, UT) closed its $225M acquisition on August 31, 2016, after the grant year, and filed Assurex's audited financials in a November 2016 8-K/A. Form 5500 shows 241 participants in 2015 and JobsOhio recorded 124 retained jobs, which places the 2016 headcount in the low hundreds.

Principal operating subsidiary of Lincoln Electric Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: LECO), Cleveland (Euclid), OH, whose 2017 10-K reports approximately 11,000 employees worldwide; Form 5500 shows 4,981 participants in 2019. Founded in Cleveland in 1895; JobsOhio recorded 2,475 retained jobs at the Euclid campus.
